title: Release check-in with a Russian-speaking contractor
scenario: Kate, a product manager in London, checks Monday's release with Dmitry, who runs a small development agency and speaks Russian full of English work words. Quick, fast back-and-forth with small overlaps; Dmitry gives the billing email the Russian way ('собака' for @).

kate.name: Kate
kate.accent_note: Product manager in London, British English. Lily: soft British voice.

dmitry.name: Dmitry
dmitry.accent_note: Agency lead, native Russian with English IT and business words. George: warm British voice.

turns.speaker: kate
turns.text: Hi Dmitry! Quick one: are we still on for the release on Monday?

ref.ru: Привет, Дмитрий! Коротко: релиз у нас всё ещё в понедельник?
ref.en: Hi Dmitry! Quick one: are we still on for the release on Monday?

turns.speaker: dmitry
turns.text: Ну... в целом да. Осталось закрыть два бага на staging, и нужен ваш approve по дизайну.

ref.en: Well... basically, yes. We still have to close two bugs on staging, and we need your approval on the design.

turns.speaker: kate
turns.notes: #overlap #gender starts 0.3 s before Dmitry ends; Russian needs the feminine 'одобрила' (Kate is a woman)

turns.speaker: dmitry
turns.text: Максимум до пятницы. Один в логине, второй в оплате через Stripe.

ref.en: By Friday at the latest. One is in the login, the other is in payments through Stripe.

turns.notes: #overlap #mixed #date Stripe in Latin letters inside Russian

turns.speaker: kate
turns.text: OK, um, and who do I send the payment confirmation to?

ref.ru: Хорошо. А кому отправить подтверждение оплаты?
ref.en: OK, um, and who do I send the payment confirmation to?

turns.notes: #question #filler 'um' in the speak direction (should be dropped, not translated)

turns.speaker: dmitry
turns.text: На billing собака nordsoft точка dev. И поставьте меня в копию, пожалуйста.

ref.en: To billing@nordsoft.dev. And please copy me in.

turns.notes: #email #mixed said the Russian way: 'собака' = @, 'точка' = dot; expect billing@nordsoft.dev

turns.speaker: kate
turns.text: Sure. And the budget is still 12,000 euros for this sprint, right?

ref.ru: Конечно. И бюджет на этот спринт всё ещё 12 000 евро, верно?
ref.en: Sure. And the budget is still 12,000 euros for this sprint, right?

turns.speaker: dmitry
turns.text: Но если добавим push-уведомления, это ещё плюс три тысячи.

ref.en: But if we add push notifications, that's another three thousand.

turns.notes: #money #numbers #mixed 'push' inside Russian; same speaker after a short pause

turns.speaker: kate
turns.text: Let's discuss that next week. Thanks, Dmitry!

ref.ru: Давайте обсудим это на следующей неделе. Спасибо, Дмитрий!
ref.en: Let's discuss that next week. Thanks, Dmitry!
